traceDiagram.title: Rename trainer command flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how `main()` makes the `rename` handler through `make_rename_handler()` when the command runs. It also shows what happens when the command renames trainer 1, and how the new name reaches the store through `save_trainer()` and the rename log through `record_rename()`.
